preservationStatement: This review performed no Git mutation of any kind (no commit, push, merge, checkout, stash, reset, or clean) and executed only read-only inspection plus the single authorized read-only npm run census:check. No bank, runtime, package script, census artifact, ledger, history, governance file, frozen manifest, comparison, accepted mapping, exception record, semantic freeze, or executor receipt was edited. No patch, bump, planning, or finalization tool was re-run. The only files created are the two receipts in this checker-owned directory.
acceptanceLimitations: Confirms the census transform only. It does not certify clinical correctness, bilingual quality, or complete answer-leakage closure.
The 451 semantic judgments were not re-run and the 66 exceptions were not resolved; both were explicitly out of scope.

Executor preservation, comparison, patch and schema-floor tooling were not re-executed; their results are attributed to recorded evidence, while the identities, live bank anchors, census content and census:check result above are this seat's own observations.
npm run census:check compares substantive content only; generatedAt and inputGitSha are excluded by the generator's stripVolatile. Both were verified separately (check 21).
The full test suite, npx tsc, npm run build and the production file:// smoke were not run here; the smoke gate was removed from this assignment by owner confirmation.
This receipt does not constitute full R4 acceptance and confers no authority to publish, commit, merge, or update PROJECT-HISTORY.md.

verdictDetail.statement: The census movement matches the reviewed repair. The only substantive change to census.json and BANK-CENSUS.md is the four authorized schema-version transitions and the version grouping they imply, plus accurate generator provenance. Every affected bank's per-file counts are unchanged, every bump is compelled by accepted typed-baseline rows actually present in the live bank, and no unauthorized census content moved.
